name: kix-rights-scale-localnet-prototype
description: Localnet-only drivers for the extended rights-scale profile: the public path (RS-1) and the private ZK path (RS-2: depth-10 circuits, manifest v2, witness reconstruction). Replays shared operation vectors against an actual Sui localnet and records observed chain state for comparison with reference/rights_scale/model.py. No real funds, no public endpoints. The fixture ceremony is single-party and is not an operational ceremony.

scripts.test:offline: node --test zk-policy-v2.test.mjs zk-helpers.test.mjs ptau-header.test.mjs witness-reconstruction.test.mjs spend-witness.test.mjs event-sources.test.mjs
